shortDescription: RSSB CET Graduate Syllabus – History, Geography, Polity, Economy, Science, Maths, Reasoning, Hindi, English and Rajasthan GK.
content:
RSSB Common Eligibility Test (Graduate Level) is usually a single objective paper (often 150 questions / 300 marks as per advt).

Broad syllabus areas

  • History of India & Rajasthan with special emphasis on Rajasthan
  • Geography of India & Rajasthan
  • Indian Polity, Economy & Rajasthan economy / schemes
  • General Science
  • Current Affairs (India, Rajasthan, World)
  • Logical Reasoning & Mental Ability
  • Basic Numeracy / Mathematics (Class 10–12 level as notified)
  • General Hindi & General English
  • Computer knowledge (basics) if included in notice

Exact unit-wise topics and marking scheme are in Advt. (e.g. 09/2026) PDF on rssb.rajasthan.gov.in.
